notes.title: Terra Lander Remastered - UPDATE AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.content:
First of all, thank you to everyone who bought the original Terra Lander, it is very much appreciated!  

Secondaly, while you may not have seen [strike]many[/strike] any updates from us for a while, we have been reading your feedback and working on this title in the background for quite some time.

[b]We are pleased to announce the updated version, [i]Terra Lander Remastered[/i] is LIVE NOW![/b]

The update includes:
[list]
[*] Refined / Improved Graphics
[*] Increased Graphical configuration options
[*] Sight Targeting System
[/list]

Should you find any bugs, issues or have anything you would like improving in the game, let us know in the comments below and we will get back to you.

Until then, Happy Landing
